audit_origin.note: The forensic receipt at r1_empty_object_schema_id_contract_forensic_review_v1.json (CONFIRMED, read-only) established that the canonical public materialization entrypoint currently returns status=MATERIALIZED_VALID_RECORD, is_valid=True, record.schema_id=None for a raw object whose own frozen schema admission evaluates to SCHEMA_INADMISSIBLE -- a direct contradiction of the frozen schema_admission_rule (r1_daily_market_evidence_schema_admission_amendment_v1.json), and that the binary MATERIALIZED_VALID_RECORD / MATERIALIZATION_QUARANTINED_NO_RECORD result model has no representable outcome for a legitimate, schema-inadmissible, zero-trade EMPTY_OBJECT observation other than forcing it into one of those two ill-fitting boxes. The forensic receipt explicitly rejected schema_id=None -> schema_id='UNKNOWN_SCHEMA' -> continue-as-MATERIALIZED_VALID_RECORD as an implementation-ready repair, because UNKNOWN_SCHEMA is classification/missingness language (r1_normalized_evidence_contract_v1.json:schema_id.missingness_semantics; r1_source_schema_registry_v1.json:policy), not a key of known_schema_variants, and recorded R1_EMPTY_OBJECT_RESULT_ALGEBRA_AMENDMENT_CANDIDATE as the recommended next lane. This candidate is that lane.

countermodel_a_current_contradiction.reason: status == MATERIALIZED_VALID_RECORD requires admission == SCHEMA_ADMISSIBLE; here admission == SCHEMA_INADMISSIBLE, so this state violates the outcome's necessary-and-jointly-sufficient conditions. This is exactly the confirmed current runtime contradiction the forensic receipt reproduced; this amendment names it forbidden, it does not itself repair the runtime.

countermodel_b_sentinel_laundering.reason: UNKNOWN_SCHEMA is not a known_schema_variants key (unknown_schema_treatment above); record.schema_id must be a non-null string equal to the admission-derived schema_id, which is only ever a registered, authorized known_schema_variants key when admission == SCHEMA_ADMISSIBLE.

countermodel_c_arbitrary_schema_substitu.reason: record.schema_id == admission-derived schema_id is a required condition; it is violated here.

countermodel_d_registered_but_unauthoriz.reason: bybit_trade_v1_rpi is registered (STRUCTURAL_LAYOUT_KNOWN) but NOT_AUTHORIZED_FOR_DAILYMARKET under the frozen registry-scope authority, so admission == SCHEMA_INADMISSIBLE; MATERIALIZED_VALID_RECORD requires admission == SCHEMA_ADMISSIBLE regardless of registry membership.

countermodel_e_payload_overlap.reason: mutual_exclusivity requires record absent when observation is present; both present violates the tagged-union invariant.

countermodel_f_near_empty_widening.reason: A decoded body of '\n' has non-zero length and reaches FRAMING_FAILURE(FEWER_THAN_TWO_TOKENS), not FRAMING_FAILURE(EMPTY_OBJECT), under the frozen recognition amendment (see empty_object_boundary.not_eligible). Only an exactly zero-length decoded body qualifies; this state is a widening of the carve-out and is forbidden.

empty_object_boundary.eligible: decoded body length == 0 -> FRAMING_FAILURE(EMPTY_OBJECT) (per r1_source_structure_recognition_amendment_v1.json:derive_header.steps, step 4) -> eligible for EMPTY_OBJECT_ZERO_TRADE_OBSERVATION
empty_object_boundary.no_broadening: This amendment does not broaden, narrow, or otherwise redefine the EMPTY_OBJECT carve-out itself -- that boundary is entirely owned by the frozen recognition amendment. It only defines what the public result envelope is permitted to do once recognition has already classified a source object as FRAMING_FAILURE(EMPTY_OBJECT).
empty_object_boundary.not_eligible: decoded body containing a newline, spaces, a comma, a BOM, a malformed header, or any other non-zero content -> not eligible for EMPTY_OBJECT_ZERO_TRADE_OBSERVATION -> ordinary quarantine/admission behavior applies instead. In particular a decoded body of exactly '\n' reaches FRAMING_FAILURE(FEWER_THAN_TWO_TOKENS) under the frozen recognition amendment's own step 5-7 (header line = '' up to the first LF, tokenizes to a single empty-string token, which fails the minimum-width-2 check) -- a different, non-EMPTY_OBJECT reason, and therefore MATERIALIZATION_QUARANTINED_NO_RECORD, never EMPTY_OBJECT_ZERO_TRADE_OBSERVATION.

entailed_semantic_situations: 1. Schema-admitted DailyMarketEvidenceV1 record (recognition RECOGNIZED, admission SCHEMA_ADMISSIBLE).

2. Legitimate EMPTY_OBJECT zero-trade observation: recognition FRAMING_FAILURE(EMPTY_OBJECT), admission SCHEMA_INADMISSIBLE by the frozen schema_admission_rule's own explicit carve-out text ('EMPTY_OBJECT receives no fabricated schema authorization'), with no recognized/authorized schema identity of any kind.
3. Quarantined malformed, unrecognized, unauthorized, inconsistent, or contract-invalid object (every other non-admitted disposition).
problem_statement.gap: The binary result model has no slot for situation 2 that is not situation 1 or situation 3. The current runtime forces it into situation 1 (MATERIALIZED_VALID_RECORD, is_valid=True, record.schema_id=None), which is a direct contradiction of schema_admission_rule condition (b). This amendment defines the missing third state without fabricating schema authorization, inventing a registered schema ID, treating an observation as admitted evidence, or changing frozen recognition, frozen schema admission, or any DailyMarketEvidenceV1 field.

Zero mechanical field violations does not by itself imply schema admission or evidence validity: a record can be field-complete and still be SCHEMA_INADMISSIBLE (e.g. a structurally recognized but scope-unauthorized bybit_trade_v1_rpi record), in which case MATERIALIZED_VALID_RECORD remains impossible.

validity_predicate.consequences: Each of the following makes MATERIALIZED_VALID_RECORD impossible for the affected record: schema_id missing; schema_id null; schema_id wrong type; schema_id empty string; schema_id == 'UNKNOWN_SCHEMA'; schema_id unregistered (not a known_schema_variants key); schema_id registered but unauthorized (e.g. bybit_trade_v1_rpi, tardis_derivative_ticker_v1, bybit_instruments_info_current_v1); schema_id different from the admission-derived schema_id.
validity_predicate.definition:
valid_admitted_daily_market_record(record, admission_evaluation) :=
    pre_existing_contract_requirements_hold(record)
    AND admission_evaluation.admission == SCHEMA_ADMISSIBLE
    AND admission_evaluation.recognition_disposition == RECOGNIZED
    AND record.schema_id == admission_evaluation.schema_id
    AND admission_evaluation.schema_id is authorized for DailyMarketEvidenceV1 under the exact bound registry-scope authority (entailed by admission_evaluation.admission == SCHEMA_ADMISSIBLE, not independently re-derived from a live registry read)
validity_predicate.no_live_registry_read_required: A conforming validator derives authorization from the already-bound admission_evaluation (or another exact authority-bound input carrying the same information), never from an implicit, ambient, or independently re-opened live registry file read at validation time.
